name: dev-core
description: Stack-agnostic engineering practices for any project: Clean Architecture and tactical DDD, test patterns (fakes, contract and repository integration tests, mutation testing), error handling, database migrations, domain events (outbox, saga), logging/observability, API contracts, auth/security, git conventions, a pre-merge review gate, resilience patterns, secrets rotation, 8 role agents (architect, tech-lead, backend/frontend developer, dba, devops, qa, appsec) that read the project's own stack and rules, and safety hooks that ask before destructive commands and before writing likely secrets.
